[[File:NagaSadowInsignia-TheGoldenAgeOfTheSith.jpg|thumb|120px|Naga Sadow's insignia]]
'''Naga Sadow's insignia''' was a personal emblem used by [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]], a famous [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] and [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] [[Sith sorcerer|sorcerer]] who lived in the fifth millennium before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was notably featured on metallic brooches worn by Sadow's [[Massassi/Legends|Massassi]] warriors. When Sadow became the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]], he traded that emblem for the circular mark of the Dark Lords.
